blocks.text: The calibration session is the item with the tighter deadline, so I have gone ahead and held three ninety-minute windows at our end, all of them in the week after next, and your assistant has them from me this morning. Whichever one you take, we come to you.

One correction to James's note yesterday. The eleventh conversation closed overnight, so we are at ten live rather than eleven, and the person stepped back for reasons of their own that have nothing to do with the role or with {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}}. James will cover it properly at the session.
On the three businesses James raised, nothing goes out to any of them until your ruling reaches us, and I have marked them held on our side so there is no chance of a call being made by accident.

The agenda is one page and it comes to you the day before, so the time in the room goes on the map rather than on catching up. If none of the three windows hold, tell me the day that suits and I will build the session around it.
